Subject: Pilot action matrix & timeline (decision owners + checkpoints)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. High level recap + proposed mutual action plan (attached as a working spreadsheet):

Pain / priority we heard
- Real-time inference costs spiking for long tail queries; current infra ops are doubling runbook effort for model tuning.
- Need predictable p99 latency < 250ms for user-facing features; burst traffic around EOD batch jobs causes variability.
- Compliance constraint: audit logs + tenant isolation for PII-sensitive flows.

Goals you called out
- 6-week pilot proving 50% reduction in median token cost at p95 latency <= 200ms for the primary inference route.
- Clear handoff to your platform team with runbook and KB by pilot close.
- Procurement sign-off for a production contract in Q1 if pilot metrics meet thresholds.

Proposed mutual action plan (summary) — draft attached:
- Week 1 (12/13): Pilot kickoff — Redwood to provide VPC onboarding guide + workload profiling job. Owner: Redwood (Lauren).
- Week 2–4 (12/14–01/04): Performance tuning + baseline runs — continuous batching + KV cache enabled. Owner: Astra Eng (Samantha) / Redwood infra (Ben).
- Week 5 (01/07): Evaluation window — shared dashboards and cost/latency comparison. Decision checkpoint: internal sponsor sign-off (Tom).
- Week 6 (01/14): Pilot close & roll recommendation — procurement and legal to confirm contract terms.

Asks from Redwood
- Confirm primary test dataset (sample S3 path) by 12/10.
- Provide procurement target date and legal contact for redlines (Tom mentioned 1/21 as budget committee meeting).

We attached a lightweight MPA spreadsheet (redwood-mpa-draft.xlsx) with milestone owners and suggested acceptance criteria. Also attached a 1-page SOW summary so your procurement folks have context.

If that looks good I propose a 30-minute sync next Monday 12/13 @ 10:00am PT to walk the onboarding steps and confirm the S3 path.

One more note: you asked about SOC 2 evidence — I’ve linked our SOC 2 summary in the sheet and can route the full attestation via your security intake after we confirm contacts.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0132
redwoodinference.com
